description: Free preflight: checks a PDF against a product's print requirements and returns previews with issues marked. Creates no order and needs no address or payment; the file is stored for the check.

all_issues.description: Return every issue instead of up to 3 per code.

option.description: Filter by any option, as key=value. Repeatable.

pdf.description: The print-ready PDF, as an https URL it can be downloaded from (at most 32 MB), or the id (fil_…) of a file sent before.

product.description: Product id or alias, e.g. flyer.

name: check
